**Subject:** Late check-in confirmation — reservation HTN789

Hello,

I have a reservation at your Midtown New York hotel, reservation **HTN789**, for **April 10–12, 2026**. I am traveling to New York on flight **AA78X9**, scheduled for **8:00–11:30 AM on April 10**.

Could you please confirm whether checking in after this flight is acceptable, and let me know the hotel’s standard check-in time and any late-arrival procedure? Please also confirm that the reservation will be held if I arrive after standard check-in begins.

Thank you.
